title: Uniqueness of normalized derived scalar/pullback comparison
statement:
Work in the unbounded small-etale derived module categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Use derived scalar extension and its specified counit [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], the ordinary scalar/pullback comparison and geometric representative [def-pur-scalar-pullback-representative-data], and K-flat complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex]. The precise proposition is:

theorem scalarPullbackIso_unique
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {Z W : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ W)
    {c d : scalarExtension φ W ⋙ L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) f) ≅
        L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f) ⋙ scalarExtension φ Z}
    (hc : ∀ (P : CochainComplex
        (Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) ℤ),
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat P →
      c.hom.app (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
          (scalarExtension φ Z).map (scalarGeometricRepresentative A f P) ≫
          scalarExtensionRepresentative φ Z
            (((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) =
        L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) f).map (scalarExtensionRepresentative φ W P) ≫
          scalarGeometricRepresentative B f
            (((ProEtale.etaleSheafExtendScalars φ W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
          _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map ((scalarSheafPullbackComplexIso φ f).hom.app P))
    (hd : ∀ (P : CochainComplex
        (Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) ℤ),
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat P →
      d.hom.app (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
          (scalarExtension φ Z).map (scalarGeometricRepresentative A f P) ≫
          scalarExtensionRepresentative φ Z
            (((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) =
        L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) f).map (scalarExtensionRepresentative φ W P) ≫
          scalarGeometricRepresentative B f
            (((ProEtale.etaleSheafExtendScalars φ W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
          _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map ((scalarSheafPullbackComplexIso φ f).hom.app P)) :
    c = d

proof.text: Ordinary scalar extension preserves quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes: after exact faithful restriction it is tensoring with the coefficient sheaf, which preserves acyclicity on K-flat complexes. Identify its specified representative map with the derived counit using uniqueness of left adjoints. That counit is invertible on K-flat inputs.

Choose the reduced functorial flat resolution. The resolution is K-flat, and its geometric inverse image is K-flat because inverse image preserves flat objects and the colimits presenting the resolution. The geometric representative counit is invertible everywhere because inverse image is exact.

Cancel the invertible scalar and geometric representative maps to identify the two components on the reduced flat resolution. Naturality and cancellation of the image of its quasi-isomorphism identify components on every cochain complex. Localization extensionality and Iso.ext give equality of the isomorphisms.
